<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern, the strong M+2 peak at ~32 % of the monoisotopic intensity matches the natural chlorine isotopic distribution (Cl‑35/Cl‑37). The M+1 intensity (~13 % of M) is consistent with the presence of multiple carbon atoms (≈12 C). No other element shows a distinctive pattern of this magnitude, so the definitively identifiable elements are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
